verses.text: Do not be jealous of evil people. Do not want to spend time with them,
because their hearts plan violence and their lips talk about causing trouble.
A house is built by wisdom and made strong by understanding.
Through knowledge its rooms are filled with all kinds of rare and beautiful treasures.
A wise person is powerful. A person with knowledge grows stronger and stronger.
You need wise guidance to fight a war, and victory comes from having many advisers.
Wisdom is too high for a fool. When the leaders meet at the city gate, he has nothing to say.
Whoever plans evil will be known as a troublemaker.
Foolish plans are sin, and people hate a mocker.
If you give up when trouble comes, your strength is very small.
Rescue those who are being taken away to death. Hold back those who are stumbling toward being killed.
If you say, "But we didn't know about this," doesn't God, who weighs hearts, see it? Doesn't the one who guards your life know it? Won't he pay back each person for what they have done?
My son, eat honey, because it is good. Honey from the honeycomb is sweet to taste.
In the same way, wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will not be cut off.
Do not hide and wait like a wicked person to attack the home of a good person. Do not raid the place where they live.
Even if good people fall seven times, they get up again, but the wicked are brought down by disaster.
Do not celebrate when your enemy falls. Do not let your heart be glad when they trip,
or the LORD will see it and be displeased, and turn his anger away from them.
Do not get upset because of evil people, and do not be jealous of the wicked,
because evil people have no future. The lamp of the wicked will go out.
My son, respect the LORD and the king. Do not join with those who rebel,
because disaster will suddenly come on them. Who knows what ruin both the LORD and the king can bring?
These are also sayings of wise people: It is not good to take sides when judging.
Whoever tells the guilty, "You are innocent," will be cursed by peoples and hated by nations.
But things will go well for those who find the guilty guilty, and rich blessings will come on them.
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
Finish your outdoor work and get your fields ready. After that, build your house.
Do not speak against your neighbour without a reason. Do not use your lips to deceive.
Do not say, "I will do to him what he did to me. I will pay him back for what he did."
I walked past the field of a lazy person, past the vineyard of someone who had no sense.
It was all overgrown with thorns. The ground was covered with weeds, and its stone wall had fallen down.
I looked and thought about it carefully. I saw it and learned a lesson:
A little sleep, a little rest, a little folding of the hands to rest,
and poverty will come on you like a robber, and need will attack you like an armed soldier.
